about.en: MarsCat (MCAT) is the native token of MarsCat, a Web3 application ecosystem that combines an AI assistant, wallet connectivity, private messaging and social features on a runtime engine running over peer-to-peer networks. The token is the BEP-20 at 0xd69a4b260ef021CCD4e1C5F5a4fB522B032Ce831 on BNB Chain.
